rows.ja: 連携先(Klaviyoの年次報告に記載)

relations.text: Shopifyとの連携が終了または低下すると、Klaviyoは顧客を失う可能性がある
relations.text_en: If its Shopify integration ends or degrades, Klaviyo could lose customers.

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: However, the termination or degradation of our integration with Shopify could cause us to lose customers if these customers do not transition to a new eCommerce platform, or if they transition to a platform that does not integrate with our platform.

relations.text: KlaviyoはShopifyに普通株を発行・売却し、2030年7月28日まで固定価格で追加株を買える選択権を与えた
relations.text_en: Klaviyo sold common stock to Shopify and gave it an option to buy more shares at a fixed price, exercisable until July 28, 2030

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: Under the stock purchase agreement, we issued and sold shares of common stock to Shopify and provided an investment option which allows Shopify to purchase additional shares of common stock at a fixed price, exercisable at any time at Shopify’s option until July 28, 2030.

relations.text: Shopifyが持つKlaviyo株の購入選択権は、2025年12月31日時点で7,500万ドルの投資に当たる
relations.text_en: Shopify's option to buy Klaviyo Series B common shares represents $75 million of its investments as of December 31, 2025

source.label: Shopify 10-K
source.quote: Our investment option derivative to purchase Series B common shares in Klaviyo, representing $75 million of our investments as of December 31, 2025, is impacted by market price volatility and interest rates.

relations.text: Klaviyoの連携先には、Googleなどの技術プラットフォームが含まれる
relations.text_en: Klaviyo integrates with technology platforms including Google.

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: We enhance our platform through our large technology partner ecosystem and robust library of integrations with other technology platforms, including Google, Meta, Zendesk, Gorgias, LoyaltyLion, Pinterest, and Canva.

relations.text: KlaviyoはAmazon Buy with Primeと連携している
relations.text_en: Klaviyo has integrated with Amazon Buy with Prime

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: We have additionally integrated with Amazon Buy with Prime.

relations.text: 2026年1月に、ChatGPT内でKlaviyoのデータを使えるKlaviyo for OpenAIアプリを公開した
relations.text_en: In January 2026 Klaviyo launched an application with OpenAI that lets customers access their Klaviyo data inside ChatGPT

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: In January 2026, we also launched the Klaviyo application with OpenAI, allowing our customers to access their Klaviyo data right inside ChatGPT.

companies.name: Adobe
companies.sub: クリエイティブソフト

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: We face competition from a number of companies, including Adobe, Salesforce, Mailchimp, and Braze.

relations.text: Magento(Adobe)を含む主要コマース基盤が、Klaviyoの提携先に並ぶ
relations.text_en: Klaviyo partners with major commerce platforms including Magento (Adobe).

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: We also partner with most other major commerce platforms, including WooCommerce, Magento (Adobe), BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, PrestaShop, and Shopware.

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: We face competition from a number of companies, including Adobe, Salesforce, Mailchimp, and Braze.

relations.text: Salesforce Commerce Cloudなどのデータ元と連携している
relations.text_en: Klaviyo integrates with data sources including Salesforce Commerce Cloud

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: We integrate with a wide range of data sources such as retail and eCommerce platforms, including Shopify, WooCommerce, and Salesforce Commerce Cloud, to comprehensively replicate all historical profile and event data in Klaviyo and synchronize data going forward.

companies.name: Braze
companies.sub: マーケティングソフト

source.label: Braze 10-K
source.quote: We face competition from software companies that offer marketing solutions, such as Adobe, Salesforce, Iterable, and Klaviyo.

relations.text_en: Braze is also a Klaviyo competitor.
